checks: Menu loads all assets and has one primary Play action.
Comic click completes current fade first; panels then reveal in order on one page.
Full-page transparent comic layers preserve earlier panels and empty captions add no text strip.
Six region buttons and city hover scaling work.
Zoom/fade transition enters a region with five settlements, two factories and real raster masks.
Station purchase via keyboard/mouse charges once; overlap and out-of-deposit clicks spend nothing.
Mouse-built 10 kV -> transformer -> 400 V network lights a village and starts income.
Fixed settlements cannot be deleted.
Pole voltage toggles with V; incompatible endpoints are rejected.
Demolition refunds actual purchase value.
Optional matrix matches the model; a nonzero cell selects the real cable.
Pause stops both active time and income.
Help pauses and resumes the prior state.
Camera zoom/pan is bounded and never changes physical cable distances.
Window blur pauses the game; it does not earn background income.
Real-mask reference network powers both factories without bypassing prices or constraints.
Factories are not hidden beneath the construction dock at the initial zoom.
HUD and all seven build tools remain within view at 1440x900, 1280x800 and 960x640.
Save reconstruction restores cash, topology and elapsed time, and resumes paused (storage fixture).
Disconnecting a factory before the deadline produces the requested failure screen.
A successful deadline illuminates and locks the completed region.
Next region keeps the treasury, stops old-region income and increases difficulty.
Developer balance fields update JSON and restart with the same seed and new budget.
No uncaught browser exceptions during all scenarios.
scope: Native Canvas; about:blank fixture, embedded assets, in-memory storage. Not Phaser or real HTTP persistence.
